class CaptchaSolverError(Exception):
    pass

def init_client(api_key):
    try:
        import capsolver
        capsolver.api_key = api_key
        return capsolver
    except Exception as e:
        raise CaptchaSolverError(f"Failed to initialize CapSolver client: {e}")
